description: VoxShield India Scam Taxonomy — 18 categories covering common Indian voice scam patterns

categories.name: Bank Impersonation
categories.description: Caller impersonates a bank employee to extract account details.
categories.recommended_action: Hang up and call your bank directly using the number on the back of your card.

categories.name: UPI / Payment Scam
categories.description: Caller tricks victim into sharing UPI PIN or sending money via UPI.
categories.recommended_action: Never share UPI PIN. Hang up immediately. Report to cybercrime.gov.in.

categories.name: KYC Scam
categories.description: Caller claims KYC update is urgently required to avoid service disruption.
categories.recommended_action: KYC is never done over phone calls. Visit your bank/telecom store in person.

categories.name: OTP Request
categories.description: Caller asks for OTP received on victim's phone.
categories.recommended_action: NEVER share OTP with anyone. No legitimate organization asks for OTP over a call.

categories.name: Digital Arrest / CBI Scam
categories.description: Caller impersonates CBI/police/customs and threatens 'digital arrest'.
categories.recommended_action: Digital arrest does not exist. Hang up. Real officers do not demand money over phone.

categories.name: Police / Government Impersonation
categories.description: Caller impersonates police, IB, ED, or other government authorities.
indicators: cyber crime se bol raha hoon
police department se bol raha hoon
categories.recommended_action: Contact your local police station directly to verify. Never pay over phone.

categories.name: Family / Friend Impersonation
categories.description: Caller impersonates a family member or friend in distress.
indicators: new number se call kar raha
categories.recommended_action: Hang up. Call the family member directly on their known number to verify.

categories.name: Courier / Parcel Scam
categories.description: Caller claims a parcel contains illegal items or needs customs payment.
categories.recommended_action: Verify tracking number directly with the courier company's official website.

categories.name: Fake Job Offer
categories.description: Caller offers a high-paying job in exchange for registration fees.
categories.recommended_action: Legitimate employers never ask for upfront fees. Verify the company independently.

categories.name: Investment / Trading Scam
categories.description: Caller promises high returns on investments, crypto, or trading apps.
categories.recommended_action: No investment guarantees returns. Verify SEBI registration at sebi.gov.in.

categories.name: Loan Scam
categories.description: Caller offers instant loan with minimal documentation but requires upfront fees.
categories.recommended_action: Legitimate lenders never ask for upfront fees. Contact banks directly.

categories.name: Lottery / Prize Scam
categories.description: Caller claims victim has won a prize but must pay a fee to claim it.
categories.recommended_action: You cannot win a lottery you did not enter. Hang up immediately.

categories.name: SIM Block Threat
categories.description: Caller threatens to block SIM unless personal details are shared.
categories.recommended_action: TRAI/DOT do not call individuals. Contact your carrier directly.

categories.name: Account Suspension Threat
categories.description: Caller threatens to suspend bank account, wallet, or social media account.
indicators: aapka account block ho raha hai
categories.recommended_action: Log into your account directly via official app/website to check status.

categories.name: Tech Support Scam
categories.description: Caller claims to be from tech support and asks for remote access or payment.
categories.recommended_action: Microsoft/Google never call proactively. Hang up immediately.

categories.name: Blackmail / Extortion
categories.description: Caller threatens victim with fake compromising material unless paid.
categories.recommended_action: Do not pay. Report to cybercrime.gov.in immediately. Contact local police.

categories.name: Identity Theft
categories.description: Caller collects PAN, Aadhaar, DOB, or other identity documents.
categories.recommended_action: Never share identity documents over phone. Hang up and report.

categories.name: Unknown / Suspicious
categories.description: Suspicious patterns detected but category not determined.
categories.recommended_action: Verify the caller's identity through an independent channel before taking any action.
